# 49 - Focus Booster

> 49 - Focus Booster is a focus-training game for iPhone built on the Schulte table, a classic attention exercise. A minute a day lets players practise sustained attention, faster reading (wider eye span), visual search and calm under pressure, and see their progress in Insights. It is a game, not a medical product. Players find the numbers 1 to 49, shuffled on a 7 × 7 board, in order and as fast as they can. A game takes about a minute. It is free to play with ads between games; 49 Premium (weekly, monthly, yearly with a free week, or lifetime) removes the ads. Nothing is locked behind a purchase. Coming soon to the App Store.

Key facts:

- Platform: iPhone, iOS 17 or later.
- Game types: Classic (one board, best time), Endless (boards keep coming), Beat the Clock (every find adds time, every miss costs time).
- Styles: Normal (a plain time trial), Competitive (points, combos and a multiplier up to ×3), Relax (effects without points).
- Boards: Numbers, Letters, Red & Black and Shifting, from 5 × 5 to 7 × 7, counting up or down.
- Competitive scoring: 100 points per number plus up to 50 for speed; ×2 from a combo of 5, ×3 from 15; the combo is lost when its timer runs out and halved by a wrong tap.
- Daily Challenge (14 rotating themes with goals) with streaks, ranks from Rookie to Legend, 482 achievements in 19 groups, 146 Game Center leaderboards (today, week, month, year, all time).
- Insights: blind spots on the board, time of day, rhythm and the most common mistakes.
- Seven looks (Classic, Focus, Neon Arcade, Zen Ink, Pit Lane, Candy Pop, Blossom) with matching app icons, a theme builder, and 16 sound styles.
- Accessibility: VoiceOver, Reduce Motion, Bold Text, Audio Graphs.
- Languages: English, Polish, German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean.
- Privacy: games stay on the device, no account. Game Center is optional. The free version shows ads from Google AdMob.
- Not a medical product: a game for practising focus.
- Support: https://github.com/49Game/49game.github.io/issues
